title: Lead Firmware Engineer
skills_required: Embedded C, RTOS, Bare-Metal Firmware, MCU/SoC Hardware Design, Analog/Digital Circuits, PCB Layout Review, EMC/EMI Debugging, JTAG/SWD, Bootloader, EtherCAT, CAN, PROFINET, IO-Link, Servo Drives, VFDs, Motion Controllers
jd_text:
We are looking for a hands-on Lead Firmware Engineer to lead and grow our Embedded Hardware and Embedded Firmware teams, taking end-to-end responsibility for technical direction, architecture, execution quality, and delivery of embedded electronics used in industrial drives, servo inverters, frequency inverters, and motion/safety products.

Products: Servo drives, VFDs, motion controllers, safety drives.

MUST-HAVES:
- BE/ME in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or closely related field
- 12+ years in embedded systems development
- Strong background in embedded firmware AND hardware (70% FW / 30% HW split acceptable)
- Currently Technical Manager / System Architect / Technical Lead, managing 4-6 engineers, still hands-on (writes code, does design/code reviews)
- Strong embedded C, RTOS or bare-metal
- MCU/SoC hardware design, analog/digital circuits
- PCB layout review + EMC/EMI debugging
- Lab skills: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG/SWD
- Bootloader + firmware update experience
- Industrial comms: EtherCAT, CAN, PROFINET, or IO-Link
- Domain mandatory: Power Electronics, Industrial Drives, Motion Control, Servo, Frequency Inverter
- Customer-facing with EU/US stakeholders
- Notice: Immediate to 30 days preferred (up to 2 months)
- Stable career (min 3 years per company)

title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer - STP Projects
skills_required: Mechanical System Design, STP Design, Equipment Selection, Engineering Calculations, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, P&ID, GA Drawings, Project Coordination
jd_text:
A Mechanical Design Engineer working in a sewerage treatment plant (STP) is responsible for designing, selecting, and supporting the installation of mechanical equipment used to treat wastewater safely and efficiently.

Responsibilities include: design of mechanical systems (pumps, blowers, mixers, screens, sludge handling, aeration); equipment selection; engineering calculations (pump sizing, pipe sizing, flow rates, pressure losses, power); preparation and review of P&ID, GA drawings, equipment layouts; coordination with civil, electrical, and process teams; site support during installation, commissioning, and testing.

MUST-HAVES:
- Mechanical Engineering background
- 5+ years designing mechanical systems for STP projects
- 5+ years in equipment selection and engineering calculations for STP
- Experience providing technical support during installation, commissioning, testing of STP
- Currently working as a mechanical design engineer for STP projects
- Notice period less than 60 days
- Good communication and project management skills

title: Application Engineer - Motion Control & Automation
skills_required: Motion Control Systems, Servo Drives, VFDs, PLC Programming, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, Machine Automation, Industrial Communication Protocols, Commissioning, Hardware Diagnostics
jd_text:
Application Engineer - Motion Control & Automation. Travel: customer-facing role with regular site visits across India (up to 80% travel). 3 positions open: 2 in Delhi and 1 in Bengaluru.

Responsibilities: architect machine automation solutions using servo drives, motion controllers, PLCs, industrial networks; lead technical discussions with customers; develop and integrate automation software; commission and validate live systems; troubleshoot complex automation issues.

MUST-HAVES:
- BE in Electrical, Electronics & Telecommunication, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or Mechanical Engineering
- 5-8 years in Industrial Automation, Motion Control, Application Engineering, or Machine Automation
- Knowledge of Electronics, Drives, PLC, servo and motion controllers
- Hands-on commissioning, programming, hardware diagnostics, root-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, report generation
- Comfortable with extensive customer interaction and travel (up to 80%)
- Notice: Immediate to 30 days
- Stable career (min 2-3 years per company)
